facts.en: Completed a nonprofit administration diploma at Fictional Wrenpath College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构鹪鹩径学院完成非营利行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid grants records assistant at Fictional Lanternseed Fund from 2021-04 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-04 至 2026-08 在虚构灯籽基金任有薪资助记录助理。

facts.en: Maintained award letters, payment schedules and recipient-submitted receipt folders.
facts.zh: 维护资助授予函、付款计划及受助方提交的收据文件夹。

facts.en: Matched payment references against schedules supplied by the finance officer.
facts.zh: 依据财务专员提供的计划核对付款编号。

facts.en: Flagged missing receipts and mismatched references for the programme officer’s review.
facts.zh: 标记缺失收据及不匹配的编号，供项目专员审核。

facts.en: The grants panel approved awards, and finance staff authorized payment release.
facts.zh: 资助评审组批准资助授予，财务人员授权付款。

facts.en: Prepared a reconciliation worksheet for the 2025 small-arts award cycle.
facts.zh: 为 2025 年小型艺术资助周期准备核对工作表。

facts.en: That cycle contained 12 approved awards totaling 48000 fictional credits.
facts.zh: 该周期有 12 项获批资助，合计 48000 虚构货币单位。

facts.en: By 2025-12-31, finance records showed 36000 fictional credits paid across those awards.
facts.zh: 截至 2025-12-31，财务记录显示这些资助已支付 36000 虚构货币单位。

facts.en: The unpaid 12000 fictional credits were scheduled for later milestones; the records do not describe them as overdue.
facts.zh: 尚未支付的 12000 虚构货币单位计划在后续里程碑支付；记录未将其描述为逾期。

facts.en: Personally linked each recorded payment to an award reference; the finance officer checked the totals.
facts.zh: 个人将每笔已记录付款关联到资助编号；财务专员核查总额。

facts.en: The award amounts were programme funds, not the candidate’s discretionary budget or personal fundraising total.
facts.zh: 这些资助金额是项目资金，并非候选人的自主支配预算或个人筹款总额。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet sum formulas, date filters and linked-document indexes.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格求和公式、日期筛选及关联文件索引。

facts.en: Prepared monthly exception lists showing missing documentation and upcoming payment milestones.
facts.zh: 准备月度异常清单，列明缺失文档及即将到来的付款里程碑。

facts.en: Completed an internal payment-records induction in 2021-04; no accounting designation was awarded.
facts.zh: 2021-04 完成内部付款记录入职培训；未授予会计专业资格。

facts.en: Co-created a receipt-folder guide in 2024-09 with the programme officer.
facts.zh: 2024-09 与项目专员共同编写收据文件夹指南。

facts.en: Personally wrote the filename examples; the officer defined acceptable supporting documents.
facts.zh: 个人编写文件名示例；可接受的支持文件由专员定义。

facts.en: Volunteered to prepare seating cards for Fictional Starling Story Night in 2023-05.
facts.zh: 2023-05 志愿为虚构椋鸟故事夜准备座位卡。

facts.en: Built a personal theatre-ticket spending log in 2022; it was unrelated to grant funds.
facts.zh: 2022 年制作个人剧院门票支出记录，与资助资金无关。

facts.en: Enjoys drawing small stage-set designs.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制小型舞台布景设计。
